tips.text: Dodge with {dodge} to roll through attacks. Practice in the training arena.
Block with {block}; a well-timed parry staggers enemies.
Defeat the floor boss, then pull the stair lever to ascend.
Open your inventory with {inventory} to equip better gear.
Vessit keeps the board by the north wall. Standing bounties reset between descents.
Some of the people still down there can walk out with you. They do not wait forever.
Lecterns and inscriptions hold the record of what happened here. Reading them is worth the detour.
